media.title: W. S. Van Dyke — portrait photograph, 1933
media.altText: Black-and-white portrait photograph of the film director W. S. Van Dyke, 1933.
media.publicCaption: W. S. Van Dyke photographed for the Los Angeles Times in 1933. Van Dyke directed San Francisco (1936), for which Kaper and Jurmann wrote “Would you?” and other songs with Gus Kahn.
